meta.prompt: Compare two phone plans side by side for me: price, data, calls, roaming, contract length and extras, with the better value on each row marked, a recommendation at the bottom with one sentence of reasoning, and a choose button under each plan that tells you which I picked.
meta.text:
Column gap:12 pad:16
  ComparisonTable names:["Plan A","Plan B"] prices:["$35/mo","$42/mo"] rows:[["Data","30 GB","Unlimited",2],["Calls","Unlimited","Unlimited",0],["Roaming","$5/day","Included",2],["Contract","24 months","None",2],["Extras","Streaming perks","Hotspot 15 GB",2]] pick:"Plan B" pickLabel:"Recommended" cta:"Choose" -> emit choosePlan
  Text.caption "Recommended: Plan B. Its unlimited data, included roaming and no contract outweigh the $7 monthly difference for most travellers."
